name: Warm Beef, Cabbage & Carrot Salad with Soy-Lime Dressing

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 small bunches green onions (scallions)
3 limes
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage
6 medium carrots

instructions.primary_message: Pat the steak dry with paper towels and slice into thin strips; place in a medium bowl.
Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the steak, toss to combine, and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the green onion (reserving a handful for garnish) and cook, stirring constantly, until browned, 1-2 minutes. Transfer to a large bowl.

Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak strips and garlic; cook, stirring frequently, until the beef is just cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Juice limes into the skillet with the beef. Add soy sauce, sugar, and pepper; stir to combine, then transfer beef and sauce to the bowl with the green onion.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim off and discard root end of each cabbage; halve the cabbages lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise and add to the bowl.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide beef and cabbage salad between plates or bowls; top with reserved green onion and enjoy!
